# Executive brief: Equipment Request Agent

## Problem

Employees need a clear way to request approved equipment and learn their manager's decision. The agent records the request and reports the outcome even when approval arrives after the conversation ends.

## Success measures

The goal is timely equipment decisions. Measure the percentage of requests with a recorded decision within two working days, using request-system submission and decision timestamps each month. The illustrative baseline is 60%; the proposed target is 90% in the first full month after launch. These are synthetic assumptions awaiting business confirmation.

## Wave 1 scope

Set up the required environments and let authenticated employees submit equipment requests by voice, confirm their details and receive a recorded manager approval or rejection.

## Exclusions

Purchasing and physical equipment delivery are outside this release.

## Top risks and kickoff blockers

Environment access is required before setup. The customer platform owner must arrange it; a needed-by date is still to be agreed. Workplace Operations must confirm the baseline and target before acceptance planning. Business and technical design reviews remain pending.

## Readiness verdict

Not ready for project setup: access and design confirmation remain open. The working design is ready for assigned reviewers to examine; this brief does not approve the design or authorize a build.
